## Detailed Product Specifications
- **Product Type**: 2-Ply Facial Tissue Box
- **SKU**: ORN-FT-100P
- **Net Quantity**: 100 N
- **Total Sheet Count**: 200 Sheets
- **Total Pull Count**: 100 Pulls
- **Ply Count**: 2 Ply
- **Sheet Dimensions**: 18 cm × 19 cm (Length × Width)
- **Maximum Retail Price (MRP)**: ₹100/- (inclusive of all taxes)
- **Item Condition**: New
- **Availability**: In Stock

## Quality & Dermatological Characteristics
- **Softness**: Feather-light surface texture designed for sensitive skin and gentle daily touch.
- **Strength**: Two interlocking plies engineered to maintain structural integrity and resist tearing when wet.
- **Hygiene Standards**: Produced under strict hygienic controls for personal care, cosmetic touch-ups, makeup removal, and facial cleansing.
- **Suitability**: Safe for children and adults across all skin types.
